citations: https://docs.cedarpolicy.com/auth/authorization.html (forbid overrides permit; no ordering; ALLOW only when a permit applies)
notes: relationships as Cedar's sharing idiom: group membership and folder parentage are the entity hierarchy, each viewer tuple is one policy `permit(principal in <subject>, action == view, resource in <object>)` (the expansion of a linked template instance per tuple); inheritance to documents comes from `resource in Folder` through the hierarchy
the corpus allow rule is r1, the catch all is the Cedar default DENY
